description: 국가철도공단_공항철도_주소데이터 [railways and stations and airports] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 국가철도공단. 공항철도에서 관리하는 도시광역철도 역들의 주소 정보를 포함한 데이터로, 철도운영기관명, 노선명(선명), 역명 등 기본 정보 외에 각 역의 지번주소와 도로명주소가 함께 제공됩니다. The portal shows 2025-11-12 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support rail network and station studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
